role_scope.independent_reviewer: No runtime, cwd, subprocess or write use of this historical copy; only this authorized readonly metadata/hash pass. All opened file handles closed before report.
role_scope.root_confirmation: Root reports prior readonly proof process reaped exit0, no remaining background process/FD and no relative-cwd use.
role_scope.sol_confirmation_via_root: Sol confirms entire current/587 phase no cwd, relative path, FD or subprocess use of exact copy; operations confined to live repo.
role_scope.active_roles: Root + Sol587 + Astra588 only, per Root coordination.
role_scope.limitations: Exact-path ps cannot discover all open FDs or relative uses; task-scoped role declarations close known task activity only, not global platform visibility.

authorization_assessment: Matches stated user authorization to release reliably restore-verified duplicate working copies while preserving unique evidence: historical successful physical restoration is bound to same archive SHA, current tree is byte-exact, and two ordinary retained archives remain outside target. This review does not delete or itself grant broader resource/Native authority.
root_release_conditions: Root must recheck root and ancestor identity and each proof-listed file identity/stat immediately before unlink; halt on any mismatch, extra, new writer or unknown relevant use.
Only unlink still-matching proof-listed files beneath exact target; remove only verified empty directories. No blind recursive removal.
Preserve both retained ZIPs, historical receipt, proof/review, live Source, other checkpoints and all unique evidence.

Save actual removal receipt and measure fresh free space separately; verified logical payload bytes are not a claim of actual freed blocks. Native authorization and fresh resource gates remain separate.
remaining_blockers: No target-specific byte/known-task-writer blocker found. Root immediate pre-unlink identity/quiescence checks remain mandatory; no claim of global process completeness or Native execution readiness.
